create_omat24_static_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE static calculation using OMat24StaticSet
create_omat24_relaxation_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE relaxation calculation using OMat24RelaxSet
create_omat24_aimd_vasp_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 AIMD simulation using OMat24AIMDSet with nvt or npt ensemble
review_omat24_aimd_thermostat_config: review the OMat24AIMDSet incar_updates property to configure nose or langevin thermostat settings
review_omat24_relax_incar_updates: review the OMat24RelaxSet incar_updates property to check IBRION NSW and ISIF relaxation parameters
